capabilityBoundary.singleAuthoringUnit: A reviewed semantic skeleton is authored into one EN/FA session pair containing instruction, embedded retrieval/application, complete feedback, and an optional bounded recap. Quiz and recap are roles inside the session, not independent production pipelines.

sourceDiscipline.duplicatePolicy: Account for every duplicate atom and link it to an explicit duplicate representation; never delete or merge by hash alone.
sourceDiscipline.coveragePolicy: Every instructional atom must be represented somewhere in the complete learning graph, but no individual session is required to repeat every atom. Split into more micro-lessons and sessions instead of bloating prose.
sourceDiscipline.sourceAuthorityPolicy: The user corpus is source and segmentation evidence, not automatic current clinical authority. Actionable or time-sensitive claims require current authoritative evidence and independent medical review.

lessonWriting.learnerPromise: Each micro-lesson has one coherent, testable learner promise.
lessonWriting.reasoningPolicy: Teach why and how at the smallest useful depth. Preserve causal chains and exceptions, but move additional mechanisms into the correct micro-lesson or optional deep feedback rather than an Enrich stage.
lessonWriting.terminologyPolicy: Explain each term at first meaningful use for the target learner; retain standard English or Latin terminology where useful and link both locales to one terminology ID.
lessonWriting.vignettePolicy: Use a short synthetic clinical vignette only when it materially improves mechanism, discrimination, diagnosis, or transfer. Do not force a patient story, name, age, sex, or demographic detail when it is not educationally relevant.
lessonWriting.mediaPolicy: Use media only for a defined learning purpose, with rights state, hashes, bilingual caption and alt text, a nonvisual equivalent, and medical review. Never infer accuracy from visual appeal or filename.
antiBloatRules: Never expand a sentence to a fixed number of lines.
Never use arbitrary word-count multiplication as a quality target.
Never preserve coverage by copying the source into one long passive lesson.
Split when a new objective, prerequisite, safety boundary, evidence version, or budget violation appears.
No interaction family may exceed half of a session unless an accessibility adaptation requires it.

embeddedQuizWriting.assessmentPlacement: Distribute retrieval, discrimination, application, repair, and checkpoint interactions through the learning sequence.
embeddedQuizWriting.coverageTarget: Assess every major concept and every clinical-high or safety-critical claim before chapter validation, then schedule delayed retrieval. A source atom does not automatically require its own question.
questionRules: Assess only taught claim IDs unless the interaction is explicitly diagnosticOnly.

Use selected response only when choices add useful discrimination; otherwise prefer constructed response, sequencing, matching, causal construction, image or signal interpretation, teach-back, or branching decisions.
Selected-response questions use stable option IDs and an answer ID, never a translated option index.
Every correct answer includes mechanism or clinical reasoning.
Every distractor has a misconception ID or explicit plausible-error rationale and a complete why-wrong explanation.
No placeholder, trick wording, irrelevant trivia, answer-length cue, unsupported fact, or punitive diagnostic item is allowed.
A retry changes representation or context instead of repeating the same item verbatim.

feedbackLayers.flash: A concise result and correction target suitable for the live interaction.
feedbackLayers.deep: Complete why-correct, why-wrong, misconception, source-atom, claim, and evidence links stored in data even when collapsed in the live flow.

rules: Reinforce only claims already taught in the linked session or micro-lesson.
Prefer retrieval, contrast, causal reconstruction, and next-review cues over passive restatement.
Do not introduce a new claim, citation, warning, dose, threshold, or management recommendation.
Do not satisfy primary source-atom coverage through a recap.
Do not duplicate a complete lesson or become a second content edition.

english.voice: calm, warm, concise, evidence-seeking, professionally credible

persian.register: natural modern Persian for medical learners; friendly but professionally credible
persian.orthography: Persian ی and ک, correct half-spaces, natural punctuation
persian.medicalTerms: Keep useful English or Latin terms at first mention and explain them naturally in Persian.
persian.bidi: Isolate Latin terms, formulas, IDs, drug names, ECG leads, numbers, and units as LTR runs.
avoid: mandatory دکتر جان or رفیق address

clinicalSafety.draftStatus: All generated content remains raw and unavailable to learners until reviewed, validated, and published through separation of duties.
hardStops: outdated time-sensitive claim presented as current
EN/FA mismatch in number, comparator, unit, dose, answer, warning, or contraindication

adoptedPrinciples: read every relevant source artifact before authoring
preserve complete source coverage through a ledger
explain terminology at first meaningful use
use purposeful clinical vignettes and media explanations
write complete why-correct and why-wrong feedback
ban placeholders and validate content beyond schema parsing
write Persian natively rather than translating word for word

rejectedRules.reason: Conflicts with one integrated session graph and the explicit no-Enrich boundary.

rejectedRules.rule: mandatory vignette, patient name, demographic distribution, or name exclusions
rejectedRules.reason: Demographics must serve the teaching point and should not encode arbitrary cultural rules.

rejectedRules.rule: mandatory informal narrator phrases, emojis, or project persona
rejectedRules.reason: Conflicts with Synapse voice, professional credibility, and repetition control.

rejectedRules.rule: legacy TypeScript schema, CSS markup, folder names, and product branding
rejectedRules.reason: Synapse uses its own provider-neutral content contract and product identity.

rejectedRules.rule: source text is sufficient medical authority
rejectedRules.reason: Current clinical claims require authoritative evidence and independent review.

externalExecution.completionRule: Jules completion is never content acceptance. Harvest raw artifacts, validate locally, and keep them unpublished until all content-contract review and promotion gates pass.
